why: In section 5 the reader writes: "The paragraph is titled משיכה אחרי 6 שנים, but the chart is set to 5 years and shows tax. Which is it?" This is a direct finding that the 5 years in the chart's setting doesn't match the 6 years in the sentence under it. It isn't general confusion about the 6-year rule. Before this, the reader raises many other problems: cut-off numbers, the salary cut off at the top, no 6-year figure, the confusing 123 label, unexplained jargon, unclear 15,712, unclear rules buttons, no help choosing a company, a confusing paragraph about moving funds, unexplained tax rules, no colour key, and a missing number on the deposit bar. That puts it at about position 15. The exact number depends on how the jargon complaints are grouped.
